title: The Last Train
_todo: Panels 1-2 of the end (docs 6.5); panels 3-5 are train_reveal (they play when the needle drops). Panel art assets/art/panels/train/train_outro_0N.png. Voice lines lenz_dying, train_outro_02 do not exist yet.

panels.shot: Train roof, rain. Lenz lies by the roof lantern, his sabre broken, smiling up at the hero. The metronome beside him has stopped.

lines.speaker: Lenz
lines.text: He said you'd still drop your left guard. He taught you that.

panels.shot: Wide, high angle. The front of the train disappears into a tunnel, its tail lamps going out. On the valley road beside the stopped dome car, a row of black cars waits with headlights on. Men in black tie lead the Board into the rain. One of them tips his hat toward the roof.

lines.text: The Choir collects. I had only been the collector.
